reference.text: Если честно, день был очень волнительным. Я рада, что мы встретились.
reference.voiceDescription: A young adult woman, about 25, native Russian with clear standard Moscow pronunciation and no foreign accent. A warm, pleasant and natural mid-range female voice. She is speaking personally to a young man she likes after her first day at work. She starts slightly tired and nervous but sincere, then sounds quietly and warmly happy to see him. A small meaningful pause between the sentences. Subtle natural emotional shift, unforced warm smile in the second phrase. Conversational pace, natural adult acting, no dramatic exaggeration, never a narrator or advertisement.
